title: Relating gammaD-crystallin conformations to local aggregate topology.
authors: Diessner, Elizabeth M; Freites, J Alfredo; Tobias, Douglas J; Butts, Carter T
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多尺度模拟研究人眼晶状体蛋白gammaD-crystallin的单体构象状态与聚集网络拓扑的关系，并比较了野生型与白内障相关突变体的构象角色差异，属于蛋白质构象与聚集的计算模拟研究，与蛋白质结构计算课题高度相关。
abstract: The structural crystallins of the eye lens must persist at high concentrations (up to 600 mg/ml in some species), while remaining solvated within a hydrogel that must endure for the life of the organism. Transient networks of interactions among these proteins may create contacts that facilitate the development of irreversible aggregation, while also contributing to the physical properties of the lens hydrogel. Although arising from complex multibody interactions, these interaction networks also depend upon the conformational states of individual protein monomers; in particular, some states may not be conducive to interaction, while others facilitate the coordination of multiple bound interactions. Here, we use multi-scale simulation to examine networks of interaction for the human lens protein gammaD-crystallin, relating monomeric conformational states to position within the aggregation graph. We identify a three-role system of conformational states, with the formation of large aggregates associated with a highly "promiscuous" set of states whose members readily interact with themselves and others. We discuss the relationship between conformational states and aggregation, considering the two-way influence between intermolecular interactions and the monomeric conformational states. Differences in role occupancies are seen between wild-type gammaD-crystallin and the cataract-associated W42R variant, consistent with the hypothesis that W42R monomers more readily occupy distributions of conformational states that are conducive to the formation of larger aggregates.
abstract_zh: 眼晶状体的结构晶状体蛋白必须在高浓度（某些物种中高达600 mg/ml）下持续存在，同时保持在水凝胶中溶解，该水凝胶必须维持生物体的一生。这些蛋白质之间的瞬时相互作用网络可能形成接触，促进不可逆聚集的发展，同时也对晶状体水凝胶的物理性质有所贡献。尽管这些相互作用网络源于复杂的多体相互作用，但它们也依赖于单个蛋白质单体的构象状态；特别是，某些状态可能不利于相互作用，而其他状态则促进多个结合相互作用的协调。在此，我们使用多尺度模拟来研究人眼晶状体蛋白gammaD-crystallin的相互作用网络，将单体构象状态与聚集图中的位置相关联。我们识别出一个三角色构象状态系统，其中大聚集体的形成与一组高度“混杂”的状态相关，这些状态的成员易于与自身及其他状态相互作用。我们讨论了构象状态与聚集之间的关系，考虑了分子间相互作用与单体构象状态之间的双向影响。在野生型gammaD-crystallin和与白内障相关的W42R变体之间观察到角色占据的差异，这与假设一致，即W42R单体更易占据有利于形成更大聚集体的构象状态分布。
